purpose: Evaluator-owned observation contract for every Unity Mode-5 task

capabilities.entity_census: GBEntity roles and lifecycle are discovered by the injected probe
capabilities.entity_geometry: Enabled colliders are preferred; enabled renderers in the marker subtree are the deterministic fallback
capabilities.role_overlap: The probe computes player-to-role and role-to-role overlap from resolved geometry
capabilities.stable_contact: The probe resolves evaluator-owned stable entity selectors and contact state
capabilities.entity_lifecycle: The probe records appeared/disappeared marker entities
capabilities.entity_state: GBObservableState exposes standardized boolean and text fields on a GBEntity; claims require independent causal corroboration
capabilities.entity_numeric_state: GBObservableState exposes standardized finite numeric fields on a GBEntity; claims require independent causal corroboration
capabilities.numeric_telemetry: GBTelemetry values are collected as candidate signals and checked against the task contract
capabilities.scene_lifecycle: The probe records loaded scene and declared-level transitions
capabilities.outcome_events: GBOutcome events are collected as corroborating signals; Python remains authoritative

identity.selector: Evaluator-owned task selectors; no candidate-defined ordinal device namespace

trust.candidate_entity_state: standardized corroborating signal; never sufficient alone for score
